chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 2025: the Champions League final against Inter. Paris break out from their own corner and find Ousmane Dembélé. He gallops away, head up… and curls it across to Désiré Doué!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Dembélé can use both feet, so the defender can’t guess which way he’ll go. He looks up… and switches the play.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Doué chests it down and shoots. It flicks off a defender and in! Paris won five–nil, their first Champions League!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Remember Dembélé: practise with both feet, so defenders never know which way you’ll go!
